build.buildCommand: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../backend && python -m pip install uv && python -m uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-hashes --no-emit-project -o requirements.txt && python -m pip install --target /app/backend/.deps -r requirements.txt

deploy.startCommand: cd /app/backend && export PYTHONPATH=/app/backend/.deps && python -m app.migrate && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips '*'
